page.overview:
Who is 6 officers killed by Wynn?

These police officers are minor characters in .

After Michael's capture, some of them along with Jamie Lloyd stand outside his holding cell to take a good look at him. Later on, a Man in Black breaks inside the station and murders all of them, along with Sheriff Ben Meeker and Deputy Tony.
